description: Read-only XRPL transaction-history lookup for one account over an optional ledger range. Use this for multiple account transactions; use n9t2_xrpl_get_transaction when a transaction hash is already known. `ledger_index_min` and `ledger_index_max` narrow the history window, while `limit` bounds the returned records; when the response includes a pagination marker, more history remains beyond the current page. The result contains account transaction records and does not modify the ledger or submit transactions, and calls are subject to the configured gateway rate limits.

account.description: XRPL classic account address whose transaction history should be retrieved.
account.title: Account

ledger_index_max.description: Optional maximum ledger index for the transaction-history range.
ledger_index_max.title: Ledger Index Max

ledger_index_min.description: Optional minimum ledger index for the transaction-history range.
ledger_index_min.title: Ledger Index Min

limit.description: Optional maximum number of transactions to return.
limit.title: Limit

name: n9t2_xrpl_list_account_transactions
